# Loc's 101 Dreadlock Studio

> Dreadlock studio based in Austin, Texas. Dreadlock installs on any hair type, retwists, extensions, instalocs and repair, plus cuts and color, from CJ's studio at 1105 Chicon St. Text a photo of your hair for a quote.

- Phone: (512) 318-7367
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Manor, Del Valle, Pflugerville, Round Rock
- Google rating: 4.6 from 151 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/locs-101-dreadlock-studio/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/locs-101-dreadlock-studio/book.html

## Services
- Dreadlock installs: New locs on natural hair, and on very straight hair too.
- Retwists & detox: Regular upkeep that keeps roots neat and locs strong.
- Loc extensions: Add length and fullness, including blonde-tipped sets. Call first.
- Instalocs & wicks: Crochet-needle instant locs you can wash and style right away.
- Maintenance & repair: Crochet and latch-hook work to tighten, fix and clean up locs.
- Cuts, color & styles: Fades, box tops, kids' cuts, color and loc styles.

## About
Loc's 101 is CJ's own salon, “specializing in all things natural,” in a low-slung stucco strip at 1105 Chicon St, East Austin. Look for the white LOCS101 banner and the periwinkle door. It's not fancy, and that's the point: clients come for the work. CJ does the installs, retwists, extensions and repairs, and teaches loc installation, maintenance and repair too. Wanda (Smilee) handles fades, box tops and designs. First-timers say they left with locs that came out right and real advice on taking care of them.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can you start dreadlocks on straight hair?
  A: Yes. Installs on straight hair run $500 to $650 for a full head depending on length, and several clients with very straight hair recommend it.
- Q: How do I get a quote?
  A: Text a photo of your hair to (512) 318-7367. You'll get a quote back by text, so you don't have to come in first.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: No. Every visit is by appointment, and new clients need to call or text before booking. Same-day appointments are $25 if there's room.
- Q: What is your deposit and cancellation policy?
  A: Cancel at least 6 hours ahead or there's a $25 charge. Straight-hair extensions need a $200 deposit 3 days before, and extension deposits are non-refundable.
- Q: Do you do retwists on locs started somewhere else?
  A: Call or text a photo and we'll tell you what your locs need. Retwists start at $90, and Monday retwists are $55.
- Q: Where are you and when are you open?
  A: 1105 Chicon St, Austin, TX 78702, in East Austin. Monday to Saturday, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. Closed Sunday.
